resources.string: This needs Memos 0.27 or newer on your server.
Reactions, linked memos and comments are on your server. They show when it can be reached.
No memos to link. Only memos that are on your server can be linked.
Archived memos can\'t be commented on.
Only the author of this memo or an administrator can tick its tasks.
While MemoCtrl is open, stay connected to your server and sync the moment something changes there
Your server looks up the title and description of links in a memo you open. Your phone never contacts those websites
Memos with a location, on a map
Add a location to a memo in the editor and it shows up here.

The map pictures come from openstreetmap.org, not from your Memos server. That website then sees which areas you look at, which is roughly where your memos were written. Your memos themselves are never sent. You can turn this off again with the map button.
Tap a dot to see its memo. Drag to move, pinch to zoom.
Tap a dot to see its memo. The dots are in the right places, but the map itself isn\'t loaded: tap the map button at the top to show it.
Your Memos shortcuts: named filters kept on the server
A saved view is a name for a filter, such as all pinned memos. They are the same ones the Memos website shows.
Kept on your server and shared with the Memos website. Hold a view to change or delete it.
Written in Memos\' filter language. Your server checks it when you save. Tap a piece to add it:
The view is removed from your server. Your memos stay.
None of your memos match this view\'s filter.
Speak now. The recording is attached to the memo as a sound file.
Recording stopped when you left MemoCtrl. Attach what was recorded, or discard it.
MemoCtrl needs the microphone to record a voice memo. Allow it in Android\'s settings for MemoCtrl and try again.
The microphone couldn\'t be started. Another app may be using it.
The ZIP file uses Memos\' own export format, so the Memos website (0.31 and newer) can import it too. It isn\'t encrypted: anyone who has the file can read your memos.
Export memos to a ZIP file
Every memo of this account with its attachments, also archived ones
Import memos from a ZIP file
A Memos export, or any ZIP of Markdown or text files
